tools.name: homerun_list_vacancies
tools.description: List job vacancies (draft, private, public, ...) with title, status, type, location type and expiry. Optionally include location, department, hiring stages (their ids are what homerun_move_application_to_stage needs), salary indication and the candidate count. GET /vacancies (scope vacancies:read).

tools.name: homerun_get_vacancy
tools.description: One vacancy by id with description, location, department, hiring stages (id + name), salary indication, candidate count and the public job and application-form URLs. GET /vacancies/{vacancy_id} (scope vacancies:read).

tools.name: homerun_list_applications
tools.description: List job applications, newest page first as the API orders them. Each item has name, e-mail, vacancy id, current stage (id + name), rating, created/hired dates and disqualified flag. Personal data: no phone number, date of birth, photo or files are returned here; ask for one application with homerun

tools.name: homerun_get_application
tools.description: One job application in full: contact details (name, e-mail, phone, city, country), links, experience/education, current stage, rating, sources and file names (notes: use homerun_list_notes). Date of birth, photo URL and file download links are never returned. Optionally include the answers to the ap

tools.name: homerun_list_notes
tools.description: List the notes on one application: id, author display name, text, sensitive flag and timestamps. GET /job-applications/{job_application_id}/notes (scope job-application-notes:read).

tools.name: homerun_list_tags
tools.description: List the company's candidate tags (id + name). GET /tags (scope tags:read).

tools.name: homerun_list_application_tags
tools.description: The tags attached to one application. GET /job-applications/{job_application_id}/tags (scope job-application-tags:read).

tools.name: homerun_move_application_to_stage
tools.description: WRITE: move ONE application to another hiring stage of its vacancy (PATCH with only the stage id; nothing else on the application changes). Get stage ids from homerun_get_vacancy. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: homerun_get_vacancy, homerun_get_application · Private data: homerun_list_vacancies, homerun_list_applications, homerun_get_application · Public sink: homerun_add_note · Destructive: homerun_move_application_to_stage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: homerun_get_vacancy, homerun_get_application · Private data: homerun_list_vacancies, homerun_list_applications, homerun_get_application · Public sink: homerun_add_note · Destructive: homerun_move_application_to_stage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
